card.name: Dose-reduction splits and linking words in dosing
card.fires_on: Two settings in drug-label text: the "re" piece inside "dose reduction" (dose-re-duction), and small linking words (for, in, the) after a number or comparison, such as before a group or a number of doses.

modes.label: Dose reduction split
modes.description: The middle piece "re" of "reduction" right after "dose" or "dose-" when talking about lowering or interrupting treatment.
modes.example: Consider discontinuation or dose<<-re>>duction of FIRDAPSE in patients

modes.label: Linking word in trial or dosing text
modes.description: A short word such as for, in or the after a rate, count or schedule, introducing a group or a dosing course.
modes.example: (approximately every 25-31 days)<< for>> the first three doses, followed by one

card.plain: It lights up on the middle of "dose reduction" and on little words like "for" or "in" that lead into a patient group or dosing schedule.
